question: Should Birdclaw formally adopt merge-by-default archive and backup imports, with explicit `--restore` for replacement, as the supported upgrade contract for existing local stores?
rationale: This is a deliberate persistent-data and CLI-default policy change; tests can validate implementation behavior but cannot determine the repository's desired compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the merge-safe default
options.body: Merge with merge-by-default and explicit restore as the documented durable import contract.

options.title: Keep replacement-oriented defaults
options.body: Request a narrower revision that preserves existing default replacement semantics and exposes merge preservation only as an opt-in mode.

recommendation.title: Accept the merge-safe default
recommendation.body: Merge with merge-by-default and explicit restore as the documented durable import contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the design and all current implementation commits for this storage and import contract.
